r0_observed: Current product main rejects file-level symlink launcher transplantation before sibling guard resolution.
Current product main also rejects launcher link count != 1, closing the same-inode hardlink transplant found by a concurrent worker.

The launcher still selects fixed_sqlite_runtime_guard_v5_candidate.py from SELF_DIR derived from its invocation path and does not locally bind its own bytes/path to a release-authoritative launcher identity.

The V5 guard contract explicitly states that it is not a substitute for trusted installation of the guard/launcher themselves and that an upstream trusted launcher/service must establish the pre-shell boundary.
The externally pinned SQLite artifact-admission Hostinger workflow run 31536877295 remained QUEUED when re-read in this run, so it is UNKNOWN and not PASS.
The accepted productive SQLite/root-anchor/service chain is therefore still not established by current evidence.

grf.generated_reality: Symlink rejection plus link-count==1 is sufficient to prevent relocation of trusted launcher bytes before sibling guard selection.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: A regular byte-for-byte copy of the launcher has link count 1 and is not a symlink; if invoked from a foreign directory, SELF_DIR points to that directory and a foreign same-named sibling guard can be selected.
grf.hidden_assumption: The launcher-local checks can establish launcher origin without an upstream release-bound ProductStart identity.
grf.falsifier: Invoke a regular copied launcher from a foreign directory containing a controlled sibling guard, while keeping a symlink transplant as a control.
grf.predicted_if_generated_reality_right: Both regular-copy and symlink transplants are denied before foreign sibling guard execution.
grf.predicted_if_counter_reality_right: Symlink is denied, but a regular copied launcher reaches the foreign sibling guard.

bounded_unusual_experiment.name: REGULAR_COPY_SIBLING_GUARD_TRANSPLANT
bounded_unusual_experiment.scope: Disposable local Linux sandbox only; no Frank database, VPS, canonical state, effect authority or Harness mutation.
bounded_unusual_experiment.baseline_control: A file-level symlink transplant of the same launcher was denied with FRANK_V0_1_SQLITE_V5_LAUNCH_DENIED:SYMLINK_LAUNCHER_PATH.
bounded_unusual_experiment.intervention: Copy the launcher as an ordinary regular file into a foreign directory, keep link count 1, place a controlled same-named V5 sibling guard there, and invoke the copied launcher as a non-root user.
bounded_unusual_experiment.rollback: Temporary sandbox and temporary test anchor removed after the experiment.

supported: Symlink and hardlink checks are useful narrow defenses but do not by themselves prove launcher origin or release identity.
A regular copy is a distinct relocation class from hardlink transplantation because it remains a non-symlink single-link file.
The authoritative closure belongs at the upstream ProductStart/deployment boundary: exact trusted launcher/guard bundle identity must be bound before launcher-local sibling selection is trusted.
counterevidence_and_limits: This experiment used a disposable local boundary mirror and does not prove that an attacker can replace or invoke the productive root-owned Frank service path.
A correctly installed root-owned, non-writable, exact-path and independently digest-pinned ProductStart could make this counterworld unreachable in production.
No productive Hostinger parent/service was observed or modified in this run.

proposal: Treat V5 launcher-local symlink/hardlink checks as defense-in-depth, not origin authority.

At ProductStart, bind one canonical launcher path plus independently trusted launcher and guard artifact digests (or an equivalently strong root-owned release bundle identity) before first writable persistence open.
Fail closed on copied/stale/sibling launcher or guard artifacts even when basename, mode, link count and SQLite version/source-id look valid.
Target-test the composed productive start chain, not isolated launcher/overlay components.
architecture_delta.rollback: No product code was changed by this run; later implementation should remain reversible while preserving existing symlink/hardlink fail-closed checks.

primary_external_evidence.finding: The WAL-reset corruption race is fixed in SQLite 3.51.3 and later; productive runtime identity still must be proven separately from version semantics.
SQLite 3.53.4 is post-fix and has a concrete published source identity.

current_parallel_evidence.hardlink_repair: Merged product main 33bb74de9074042e3c1a186ea3f22d2ea8a572f4; dedicated target regression passed.
